title: National Observatory of Children Hospitalized With Bronchiolitis
official: National Observatory of Children Hospitalized With Bronchiolitis
summary: OVNI3 is multicenter, non-interventional study based on the analysis of retrospective patient data extracted from medical records and collected as part of routine clinical care following hospitalization for bronchiolitis
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children under 12 months
* Treated at one of the 12 study sites
* From October 15, 2025 to February 15, 2026
* For acute bronchiolitis defined according to current national and international recommendations
* Hospitalized

and

* RSV testing
* Known nirsevimab immunization status for the ongoing 2025/2026 season

Exclusion Criteria:

* Refusal to participate by the legal representative
* Maternal immunization with abrysvo after September 1st 2025
sponsor: Association Clinique Thérapeutique Infantile du val de Marne
